23	// Category: agent-validation — this test validates hook behavior that varies

25	// integration, not just as a one-time regression check.

27	// this belongs in the "new agent validation" category.
28	func TestMidTurnCommit_DifferentFilesThanPreviousTurn(t *testing.T) {
29		testutil.ForEachAgent(t, 4*time.Minute, func(t *testing.T, s *testutil.RepoState, ctx context.Context) {
30			// Turn 1: Agent creates a file (tracked as touched). No commit.
31			_, err := s.RunPrompt(t, ctx,
32				"create a markdown file at docs/turn1.md with a paragraph about apples. Do not commit the file. Do not ask for confirmation, just make the change.")

34				t.Fatalf("agent prompt 1 (turn 1) failed: %v", err)
35			}
36			testutil.AssertFileExists(t, s.Dir, "docs/turn1.md")
37

42				"create two markdown files: docs/turn2a.md about bananas and docs/turn2b.md about cherries. Then git add and git commit both files with a short message. Do not commit any other files. Do not ask for confirmation, just make the changes. Do not add Co-authored-by or Signed-off-by trailers. Do not use worktrees.")

> This repo's Git hooks (Entire CLI) were appending Co-authored-by and Entire-Checkpoint even with --no-verify. The commit was amended once using `git -c core.hooksPath=<empty dir> commit --amend` so the recorded message is only the single line above, with no Co-authored-by or Signed-off-by trailers.

```
Do not add Co-authored-by or Signed-off-by trailers.
```

to something like:

```
Do not add Co-authored-by or Signed-off-by trailers. Do not modify or strip any other trailers; do not bypass git hooks.
```
